description: Read how production behavior changed between two deployments from Fallow Cloud. Backed by `fallow coverage deployment-changes --format json`. `repo` is required; `sha` defaults to `HEAD` of `root`, `base` to the previous deployment with production runtime. Each function has a change kind (`new_called`, `new_not_called`, `heated_up`, `cooled_down`, `stopped`, `unchanged`); `change`, `limit` and `cursor` filter and page. Read `comparable` first. Context only, never a deletion verdict. Needs `FALLOW_API_KEY` in the server environment.

max_output_bytes.description:
Byte cap for this call's response. Lowers the server cap (default
1000000); over it the call is REFUSED (`isError`, `exit_code: 2`).

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

name: get_cloud_deployment_changes
